actual: The source PR merged first; missing evidence then blocked the finalizer, while the wrapper still returned merged_close_synced and requested cleanup. Finalizer state also wrote close_synced on blocked results. Close-sync polling exhausted after about 3.5 minutes while required CodeQL occupied the only runner for about 6.5 minutes.
